title: Bharti Singh And Haarsh Limbachiyaa Celebrate FIRST Lohri With Baby Kaju | Television News - News18
text: Comedian Bharti Singh and her husband, writer-producer Haarsh Limbachiyaa , are enjoying the joys of parenthood for the second time. The couple, who welcomed their second child on December 19, have been sharing heartwarming glimpses of their growing family on social media and their YouTube channel, Life Of Limbachiyaas. Recently, they marked their first Lohri with their newborn son. Haarsh shared moments from the festivities on social media, offering fans a glimpse into their intimate family celebration. Bharti Singh And Haarsh Limbachiyaa Celebrate Lohri With Baby Kaju The pictures show Bharti and Haarsh beaming with joy as they embraced the little one in their arms with warmth and love. Though the couple chose not to reveal baby Kaju’s face, the photos beautifully captured their joy as a family of four. Their elder son, Lakshya, affectionately known as Gola, also appeared in the photos and looked every bit the proud big brother. Fans’ Reaction To The Adorable Post As expected, fans and followers flocked to the comments section of the post to share their varied reactions. They were quick to shower love on the post. “Hayyeee. Cutie pie," a fan wrote. Another commented, “God bless you and your family. You both are so humble. Love you all." Even Tejasswi Prakash commented on the sweet post. “Hhaaaayyyeee," she wrote. Bharti Singh And Haarsh Limbachiya’s Family The couple tied the wedding knot in 2017 after dating for several years. Bharti and Harssh have since been one of the most loved couples in the entertainment industry. Already parents to their three-year-old son Laksh Singh Limbachiyaa, also called Gola, Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa welcomed their second child, a baby boy, on December 19. The couple is now enjoying life with two little boys, and fans are loving every update about their growing family.
